summary: V50.z508 — backend coverage of deeplink-map, routes manifest/rescan, stress autofix + nightly settings + notification validated. 16/17 backend tests pass + 1 xfail documenting a real bug in deeplink-map truncation. Frontend code review confirms all required testIDs exist in /app/frontend/app/axon-stress-report.tsx (stress-autofix-box line 240, stress-nightly-autofix-on/off lines 207-208, 'Applicata automaticamente' line 318). Full UI validation of the dynamic autofix-box + chip toggle couldn't be completed from the automation harness because the ?run=<id> query param didn't deep-link the UI to the target run (default view redirects to the most recent run which had 0 failed items) and session persistence between runs was flaky.

minor.issue: BUG REAL: in axon_deeplink_map.py:81 the ALTRE SCHERMATE REALI extras line is truncated with extra[:80]. With 98 extras today a newly added route (e.g. /zz-probe which sorts last alphabetically) is NOT injected into Axon's prompt map, so Axon won't learn the new deep-link marker. Repro: touch /app/frontend/app/zz-probe.tsx → POST /axon/routes/rescan → GET /axon/deeplink-map?refresh=1 → '[[NAV:/zz-probe|' absent. stats returned: {routes:78, extra_routes:98, chars:15333}. Fix: remove the [:80] cap or raise to e.g. 500, or always include newly-added routes (RR_STATE.added) unconditionally.

integration_issues.issue: Opening /axon-stress-report?run=st_23c3361311 does not pre-select that run — the UI loads the default (most recent) run, so stress-autofix-box is hidden when the latest run has summary.failed=0. The ?run= query param appears to be ignored or lost by the client router. Verify loadRun(run) is called with router.params.run on mount.

action_items: FIX /app/backend/routes/axon_deeplink_map.py: remove the extra[:80] cap on line 81 (or raise to ~500) so every real route surfaces in the deep-link map after rescan — otherwise newly-added screens beyond the 80th alphabetical extra are invisible to Axon.

FIX /app/frontend/app/axon-stress-report.tsx: honor the ?run=<id> query param on mount so direct links (used by notifications' deeplink '/axon-stress-report?run=…') preselect the target run and render the autofix recap box.

DOC: the review-request's '403 for demo@advisoros.it' expectation is wrong — demo is role=owner (Master of its own tenant) so it correctly gets 200 on /axon/deeplink-map and 404 on /axon/stress/autofix/<unknown>. True non-owner (consulente.test@dalpastro.it, role=consultant) is correctly rejected with 403 — verified.
critical_code_review_comments: axon_deeplink_map.py relies on monkey-patched globals via noqa:F821 (db, _ST_QUESTIONS, _nav_intent, logger, api_router, …). Works today only because the module is imported after server.py defines these; any import-order regression breaks silently.

axon_stress_autofix.py performs mutating item patches via arrayFilters-less positional operator — if two autofix runs overlap on the same run_id, only the first matched item per update will be touched. Not a user-facing bug today.

success_rate.frontend: partial — testIDs verified in source but dynamic flow not fully exercised (see action items)

rca_of_issue: Deep-link map truncation: in _dl_build the extras list is built from `sorted(r for r in real if r not in by_route and …)`, then the user-visible 'ALTRE SCHERMATE REALI' line is produced as `… for r in extra[:80]`. With 98 real schermate today, routes 81…98 (alphabetically) are silently dropped, so Axon cannot answer a navigation question about them even though axon_route_rescan correctly detected and persisted the new routes.
